inputs.label: Wing Commander II (DOS)
inputs.help: Your installed Wing Commander II, or the WING2 folder of the DOS CD-ROM: the folder that holds WC2.EXE and GAMEDAT. Kilrathi Saga data should also work.

steps.why: The game reads /sdcard/WingCommander2. The guide has the user allow access to all files on the first start.

steps.text: Open Wing Commander II VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it.

notes: The GOG install folder name and the GOG layout are not stated in the guide; the DOS CD-ROM edition with Special Operations 1 and 2 is the tested one. The release also carries WingCommanderIIVR-1.0.1.zip and a .sha256 file, which the asset pattern does not match. The tag prefix is quest-vr-.
